verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text API reference documents a multichannel mode in which each channel is transcribed independently, with an option (multichannel_output_style='combined') to merge them instead. This directly lets a developer keep each side of a call separate via the documented API and SDKs. Missing for 10: details on channel-count limits and the per-channel response structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration of per-channel transcription.
